tasks.short: Design, make and decorate furniture parts

steps.what: Design furniture details from measurements, materials and intended appearance
Create and decorate furniture parts, adjusting details against the actual piece

tasks.design: Keep sketches in {DOCS} and retain hands-on design and decoration. Digital reference images may help discussion, but they do not establish fit, surface response or workmanship.
tasks.previous_blocker: The design depends on the actual furniture and materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document storage can retain sketches; no new automation is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Turning a visual intention into a durable, well-fitting physical detail.
tasks.human_edge: Judging proportions, material behaviour and finish by direct inspection.
tasks.altitude: The week and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Custom furniture decoration requires physical craft and material judgement; no labour reduction is established for this design.

assumptions: Boundary starts with the furniture and agreed design brief and ends with the decorated part; sales and later delivery are outside this task.
The finisher measures dimensions and assesses material condition in s1; there is no assumed structured geometry, finish code or automatic input producer.
Test existing drawing and document features before considering custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the method and existing document storage remain unchanged.
unknowns: Whether repeat designs already use measured drawings
research_questions: Does a representative sample contain repeated drawing work that can be separated from fitting and decoration?

already_counted.description: Measuring and establishing the decoration plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Bespoke fit and physical decoration remain fully counted; faster image generation alone does not establish a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains responsibility for design and physical workmanship.
reach: Work with cabinetmakers on replacement details
role.ambitious_version: Build a portfolio of repeatable decoration details after measuring their fit and quality.
